education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering (AI & DS)

projects.description: Built an AI-driven recruitment platform that parses PDF/DOCX resumes, extracts candidate skills/projects, and ranks applicants using hybrid ATS scoring combining BM25 keyword retrieval and Sentence-Transformer semantic matching. Developed a GitHub verification engine leveraging GraphQL APIs to evaluate repository authenticity, coding activity, technology alignment, and project credibility through configurable multi-factor candidate assessment. Generated explainable hiring reports with ATS score, GitHub score, matched/missing skills, and final candidate rankings, enabling recruiters to shortlist applicants faster and with higher confidence.

Developed a non-custodial wallet SDK enabling autonomous AI agents to securely manage digital assets, sign transactions, and interact with blockchain networks through a unified abstraction layer. Implemented programmable payment workflows using x402-based agent-to-agent transactions, spend controls, and policy-driven authorization mechanisms for automated service payments. Built a modular multi-chain architecture supporting wallet management, transaction monitoring, and developer-friendly APIs for integrating payment capabilities into agentic AI applications.

Architected a high-performance Model Context Protocol (MCP) server in Rust to bridge autonomous AI agents with project management APIs, enabling seamless automation of issue tracking, Git workflows, and documentation. Engineered a modular toolkit of 36+ asynchronous tools with granular feature-flag controls, allowing AI clients to securely execute read/write operations across pull requests, wikis, and shared files without compromising system integrity. Implemented a standardized category_resource_action naming convention and strict stateless routing to optimize tool discovery and context filtering, significantly reducing token overhead for LLMs managing the software development lifecycle.
